wholePhysicalScope: Mapped outline and the Historic American Buildings Survey set the original masonry body and polygonal south room. Two exact March 2010 exterior photographs establish the cream wraparound veranda, tall paired upper windows, eave brackets and roof silhouette.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the brick mansion, wraparound veranda, octagonal south room and roof cupola. Closer levels refine the tall arched windows, column capitals and bracketed cornice.
limitations: The model covers the original Hull mansion as restored and photographed in 2010. The separately mapped Residents’ Dining Hall is a separate building.
Survey dimensions control the principal volumes and windows. Roof, small trim details and rear elevation are interpreted from the available views and written survey.
The original public source terrain is unchanged. The entrance landing and ground registration are approximate.
